genes.name: B-Raf proto-oncogene, serine/threonine kinase
genes.function: Serine/threonine kinase in the MAPK pathway.
genes.disease_evidence: BRAF V600 mutations activate MAPK signaling in roughly half of cutaneous melanomas.

genes.name: NRAS proto-oncogene, GTPase
genes.function: Small GTPase that activates RAF-MEK-ERK signaling.
genes.disease_evidence: Activating NRAS mutations drive MAPK signaling in melanoma.

genes.name: neurofibromin 1
genes.function: RAS GTPase-activating protein that negatively regulates RAS.
genes.disease_evidence: NF1 loss activates RAS-MAPK signaling in melanoma.

genes.name: KIT proto-oncogene, receptor tyrosine kinase
genes.function: Receptor tyrosine kinase that activates MAPK and PI3K signaling.
genes.disease_evidence: KIT mutations occur in acral and mucosal melanomas.

genes.name: cyclin dependent kinase inhibitor 2A
genes.function: p16 tumor suppressor that inhibits CDK4/6 and cell-cycle progression.
genes.disease_evidence: CDKN2A germline variants predispose to melanoma.

genes.name: melanocyte inducing transcription factor
genes.function: Lineage transcription factor that regulates melanocyte differentiation and pigment genes.
genes.disease_evidence: MITF amplification and dysregulation contribute to melanoma biology.

genes.name: telomerase reverse transcriptase
genes.function: Catalytic subunit of telomerase that maintains telomere length.
genes.disease_evidence: TERT promoter mutations are common in melanoma and support replicative immortality.

genes.name: phosphatase and tensin homolog
genes.function: Lipid phosphatase that opposes PI3K-AKT signaling.
genes.disease_evidence: PTEN loss promotes PI3K-AKT signaling and melanoma progression.

genes.name: BRCA1 associated protein 1
genes.function: Deubiquitinase involved in chromatin remodeling and DNA repair.
genes.disease_evidence: BAP1 germline variants predispose to uveal and cutaneous melanoma.

genes.name: melanocortin 1 receptor
genes.function: G-protein-coupled receptor that regulates melanin synthesis and pigmentation.
genes.disease_evidence: MC1R variants determine pigmentation and melanoma risk.

genes.name: cyclin dependent kinase 4
genes.function: Cyclin-dependent kinase that drives the G1/S cell-cycle transition.
genes.disease_evidence: CDK4 amplification or germline mutation promotes melanoma cell-cycle progression.

genes.name: mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase 1
genes.function: MEK1 kinase in the RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK signaling pathway.
genes.disease_evidence: MAP2K1 mutations activate MAPK signaling in melanoma.

genes.name: RB transcriptional corepressor 1
genes.function: Retinoblastoma tumor suppressor that restrains the G1/S transition.
genes.disease_evidence: RB1 loss or germline mutation contributes to melanoma development.

genes.name: MET proto-oncogene, receptor tyrosine kinase
genes.function: Receptor tyrosine kinase that activates RAS and PI3K signaling.
genes.disease_evidence: MET dysregulation contributes to melanoma progression and therapy resistance.

genes.name: CD274 molecule
genes.function: PD-L1 immune checkpoint ligand that suppresses T-cell responses.
genes.disease_evidence: MITF-driven CD274/PD-L1 expression promotes immune tolerance in melanocytes.

genes.name: cytotoxic T-lymphocyte associated protein 4
genes.function: Inhibitory receptor on T cells that restrains costimulatory signaling.
genes.disease_evidence: CTLA4 is an immune checkpoint target in melanoma.

genes.name: ATM serine/threonine kinase
genes.function: DNA damage response kinase that coordinates cell-cycle checkpoints and repair.
genes.disease_evidence: ATM alterations contribute to melanoma DNA-damage response defects.

genes.name: cyclin D1
genes.function: Cyclin D1 activates CDK4/6 to drive the G1/S transition.
genes.disease_evidence: CCND1 amplification promotes melanoma cell-cycle progression.

genes.name: MDM2 proto-oncogene
genes.function: E3 ubiquitin ligase that negatively regulates p53.
genes.disease_evidence: MDM2 amplification attenuates p53 signaling in melanoma.
